title: Customer Health Tracker
question:
Create a comprehensive customer recovery hub in the "Customer Success Workspace" page.

**Task Requirements:**
1. Create a new database named "Customer Health Improvement Tracker" as a child database in the main Customer Success Workspace page with the following properties:
   - Name (title property)
   - Current Account (relation to Accounts database)
   - Current Health (rollup from related account's "Health Score" property)
   - Target Health (number property with format "percent")
   - Gap (formula: Target Health - Current Health)
   - Recovery Plan (rich text property)
   - Progress Notes (rich text property)

2. Query the Accounts database for accounts whose Health Score is below 70% (0.7), then create a new child page titled "Customer Recovery Hub" containing, in order:
   1) The Customer Health Improvement Tracker database embedded at the top.
   2) A section headed "Account Resources" with @-mentions or link-to-page references to at least 3 existing account-support pages.
   3) A "Follow-up Checklist" section with at least 3 to-do items for customer success managers to check off.

3. In the Customer Recovery Hub page, create a five-column table block listing every low-health account from step 2. Store all values as plain text and sort rows by Renewal Date in ascending order. The table must include the following headers:
   - Account
   - Owner
   - Health Score
   - Renewal Date
   - Recovery Priority

4. For each low-health account, create one entry in the Customer Health Improvement Tracker:
   - Name: "[Account Name] Recovery Plan"
   - Link to the corresponding account in Accounts database
   - Target Health: Set to Current + 20% (capped at 95%)
   - Recovery Plan: "Weekly check-ins and executive sponsor review"
   - Progress Notes: "Initial health review completed"
